# Backtest results (auto-generated by `ml/write_report.py`)

Walk-forward, quarterly retraining from 2022-01-01 to 2026-10, seed 42. Day-level false-alarm budget 3%, false alert episodes budget 1.0/chokepoint-year. Persistence 2 days to raise, 3 to clear.


## 14-day horizon (production): logistic model, 44,864 chokepoint-days

| System | Precision | Recall | F1 | False-alarm rate | Events warned before traffic fell | Events detected at all | Median lead (days) | False alert episodes / chokepoint-year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Vantage** (model + observed drop) | 36.6% | 75.4% | 0.492 | 2.94% | 11 / 23 | 17 / 23 | +10.0 | 0.95 |
| Previous app scoring | 30.1% | 73.4% | 0.427 | 3.84% | 10 / 23 | 20 / 23 | +0.5 | 1.82 |
| Naive: 7d vs 90d drop > 15% | 21.4% | 76.9% | 0.335 | 6.36% | 10 / 23 | 22 / 23 | -1.0 | 2.83 |
| Naive, tuned drop threshold | 54.0% | 56.6% | 0.553 | 1.09% | 5 / 23 | 8 / 23 | +7.5 | 0.64 |

Model probability (days when the chokepoint is in normal state; 238 positive days of 41,140): ROC-AUC **0.801**, PR-AUC **0.093** (16.2x the 0.58% base rate), Brier 0.00562 vs 0.00575 for always predicting the base rate (skill +2.3%), uncalibrated Brier 0.1793.

Early-warning stratum only (chokepoints still at >= 85% of normal traffic, where reactive rules are blind): Vantage TP 83, FP 631, FN 155; previous scoring TP 35, FP 385.

## Model families (14-day horizon)

| Model | ROC-AUC | PR-AUC | Early-warned events | False alert episodes / yr | Day false-alarm rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Logistic regression (14 features) - production | 0.801 | 0.093 | 11 / 23 | 0.95 | 2.94% |
| LightGBM (26 features) | 0.800 | 0.063 | 11 / 23 | 1.09 | 3.01% |

Production model chosen by a rule fixed before looking at the comparison: higher PR-AUC at the 14-day horizon, tie-broken by fewer false alert episodes. It is also exactly interpretable (contribution = coefficient x scaled value).


## 7-day forecast (quantile LightGBM, walk-forward)

MAE 0.0731 vs 0.0873 for persistence (16.3% better); the 80% interval covers 78.7% (mean width 0.22). On the 872 chokepoint-days followed by a week below 70% of normal, the forecast is **worse** than persistence (MAE 0.303 vs 0.215): sudden collapses are not predictable from transit data.


## Red Sea case study

Replayed news layer (deterministic headline score, 7-day window): crossed 45 on **2023-11-15**, crossed 70 on **2023-11-19**. Trained transit model (walk-forward, Bab el-Mandeb): first alert **2023-12-19**; previous traffic-only scoring: **2023-12-22**. Major carriers announced pauses on 15-18 Dec 2023 (public reporting), so the trained transit model alerted about as the carriers reacted, while the news layer was about four weeks earlier. The transit model did not use the headline surge from 20 Nov because no comparable event existed in its training data.

| Alert date | Hazard score | Decision | Suez route (days, expected cost) | Cape route (days, expected cost) | Expected saving |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2023-11-15 | 51 | REROUTE | 21.8 d, $3.61M | 31 d, $1.86M | $1.75M |
| 2023-11-19 | 94 | REROUTE | 21.8 d, $7.56M | 31 d, $1.86M | $5.70M |
| 2023-12-15 | 99 | REROUTE | 21.8 d, $8.17M | 31 d, $1.86M | $6.31M |
| 2023-12-19 | 99 | REROUTE | 21.8 d, $8.17M | 31 d, $1.86M | $6.31M |
| 2023-12-22 | 99 | REROUTE | 21.8 d, $8.17M | 31 d, $1.86M | $6.31M |
| 2024-01-02 | 99 | REROUTE | 21.8 d, $8.17M | 31 d, $1.86M | $6.31M |

Shipment: Containerised electronics, $85M critical cargo, Singapore to Rotterdam, 16 kn, $60k/day. Costs are the app's cost model (expected values under stated assumptions), not realised losses.
